question.text: In evaluating the track record of an Investment Manager during DD, Ch 12 specifies the MINIMUM review period for historical fund/investment performance as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 12 under 'Track Record of the Investment Manager': 'Historical performance of the funds/investments previously managed by the Investment Manager should be thoroughly analysed over a minimum of five years'. The Trap: Common off-by guesses. 3 and 2 years are too short; 10 is overly long. Cross-Exam Context: Same 5-year lookback appears in disciplinary-history checks (next question concept). XXI-B (PM) similarly uses 5 years for performance disclosure norms. Manager's Pro-Tip: Even if your firm is <5 years old, provide the 5-year track record of the KEY PERSONS from prior roles (with permission from prior employers where applicable). LPs accept 'carry-over' track records if well-documented.
